status: V4 SHADOW concept list. Each concept needs a play spec (play_status needs_spec) before it can be produced; 'play' names an existing tactical/plays file when there is one.

concepts.variant: twist: wedge into second ball screen
concepts.question: Why does the second screen beat the switch?
concepts.cta: Comment TWIST if your team runs it.
concepts.source: standard FIBA/European half-court action (generic coaching knowledge)

concepts.variant: shooter reads the trail: curl or fade
concepts.question: Curl or fade: who decides?
concepts.cta: Tell us which read you teach first.
concepts.source: standard FIBA/European half-court action (generic coaching knowledge)

concepts.variant: zip cut into empty-side pick and roll
concepts.question: Why empty the side before the screen?
concepts.cta: Comment ZIP if you would run it in your league.

concepts.variant: pin down into dribble hand-off
concepts.question: What does the hand-off give the shooter?

concepts.source: standard FIBA/European half-court action (generic coaching knowledge)

concepts.variant: two wing cuts into middle ball screen
concepts.question: Which defender gets lost first?

concepts.source: standard FIBA/European half-court action (generic coaching knowledge)

concepts.variant: UCLA screen: cutter posts the mismatch
concepts.question: Who is the screen really for?

concepts.variant: ice the side ball screen to the baseline

concepts.variant: switch and front the small-on-big post

concepts.variant: hard hedge and two-step recover

concepts.variant: short closeout, high hands, chase the drive

concepts.variant: X-out after the skip

concepts.variant: tag the roller from the weak side, then recover

concepts.variant: screener slips before contact against a hard hedge

concepts.variant: handler rejects the ICE screen to the middle

concepts.variant: ghost the screen against a switching defence

concepts.variant: wing back-cuts the denial, big hits him

concepts.variant: defender goes under: flip the screen

concepts.variant: 6 seconds left: drive, kick or reset screen
